explanations: Node lowercases incoming header names in `req.headers`, so the keys are `authorization`, `cookie` and `x-sync-device-secret`. `scrubHeaders` checks `name in out` with the capitalized names from REDACTED_HEADERS, which never match, so every 5xx log line contains the bearer token, session cookie and device secret in clear text. The list should be lowercase (or the comparison case-insensitive), as `scrubQuery` already does.

`bodyPreview` returns undefined when `req.is("application/octet-stream")`, which is the content type for raw chunk uploads, so the body is never serialized. The other choices describe behaviour the function never performs.

In the `finish` handler, only the `res.statusCode >= 500` branch spreads in headers, query and body; other requests log only the summary `entry`. LOG_LEVEL filters by level but does not choose these fields, and x-request-id only affects the id.
`scrubQuery` checks `REDACTED_QUERY.has(k.toLowerCase())`, so `Share_Key` matches `share_key` and its value is replaced. Nothing drops or rejects unknown query parameters.
